published_objective: Weighted relative property residuals, with empirical property weights, half weights for graph-extracted or less reliable data, explicit exclusions and qualitative physical penalties.

user_requested_diagnostic.objective: Sum of squared relative residuals, equal weight per recovered observation.
user_requested_diagnostic.selection: All recovered cited rows retained; excluded or unavailable source rows identified explicitly.
user_requested_diagnostic.note: Equal weights are a user-directed alternative objective, not an assumption about the documented original weights.
